summary: Phase 3 (Equipment CSV Import) fully tested. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests PASSED — Axis_Product_List.csv imports created=26 / skipped=0 / errors=[]; persisted rows correctly split into 14 CCTV + 12 Access Control (note: spec said 'all CCTV' but actual CSV has mixed System column values; backend correctly maps based on the per-row System column); each row has manufacturer='Axis Communications', non-empty part_number, msrp>0, cost=dealer_cost>0, sell_price=proposal_sell_price>0; empty body returns created=0 with error; CSV with only Manufacturer column returns skipped=2 + 'missing manufacturer or model' errors; System->Category mapping verified for Access Control, IDS, Intercom, Network->Network/Headend, Cabling; regression POST /api/equipment still accepts both new (part_number/msrp/sell_price) and legacy minimal payloads (defaults to '' / 0.0). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Equipment tab shows new testID 'import-equipment-button' (cloud-upload icon) to the LEFT of testID 'add-equipment-button'; tapping it navigates to /equipment/import; modal renders hero card ('Bring your price book'), 7-row Recognized Columns table, and 'Pick CSV files' CTA (testID 'pick-csv-button'); pick button does not crash on web (browser file dialog is non-interactive in headless Playwright as expected); close-import returns to Equipment Library. End-to-end verified: seeded 26 Axis rows via POST /api/equipment/import then confirmed in UI — All chip shows 26 Axis rows, CCTV chip filters to 14 (sample PN 02124-001 visible), Access Control chip filters to 12.

issues: Import + Add header buttons are 36x36 px which is below the 44x44 mobile touch-target guideline. Same sizing existed for add button in prior iterations so this is pre-existing, but worth flagging.

action_items: Spec/data discrepancy (informational, not a bug): the review request states 'Each row has category=CCTV' but the actual Axis_Product_List.csv contains 14 CCTV + 12 Access Control rows (System column). Backend categorization is correct — main agent may want to update the user-facing copy accordingly.
Optional polish: enlarge the import-equipment-button and add-equipment-button hit area from 36x36 to 44x44 to meet mobile touch-target guideline.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/equipment/import is clean: tolerates BOM, uses csv.DictReader, _norm_header strips non-alphanumerics for flexible header matching, _pick handles multiple candidate column names, _parse_float strips $/,/% safely, _map_category supports both exact key + substring fallback, errors list capped at 20 so response stays small, bulk insert_many for efficiency.
Equipment model adds part_number/msrp/sell_price with defaults so legacy create payloads still validate (verified by regression test).

Frontend import.tsx correctly: handles both web (asset.file.text()) and native (fetch(uri).text()) paths, multi-file loop with per-file results, busy/disabled states on CTA, testIDs on all interactive elements, SafeAreaView + ScrollView + footer KeyboardAvoidingView-style layout.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 Phase 3 CSV import + Phase 1/2 still green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 3 flows (header buttons, modal render, navigation, category filter on seeded data, close)

Frontend route /equipment/import uses expo-document-picker (multi-file); cannot trigger native file dialog in Playwright headless on web — verify UI render + navigation only, then seed via API for downstream tests.
